intro_zh: 西安是陕西省省会，古称长安，十三朝古都、丝绸之路起点，拥有兵马俑与古城墙，是中华文明的重要发祥地。
intro_en: Xi'an, capital of Shaanxi, was the ancient Chang'an—capital of thirteen dynasties and start of the Silk Road, home to the Terracotta Warriors and the city wall.
culture_zh: 周秦汉唐的厚重历史、雄伟的城墙与钟鼓楼、回民街的烟火，还有秦腔与皮影，让西安处处是历史。
culture_en: The weight of Zhou-Qin-Han-Tang history, the mighty walls and bell tower, the bustle of the Muslim Quarter, Qinqiang opera and shadow puppetry—history is everywhere in Xi'an.

attractions.desc_zh: 秦始皇陵的陪葬军阵，「世界第八大奇迹」。
attractions.desc_en: The buried army of Emperor Qin—the 'Eighth Wonder of the World'.

attractions.desc_zh: 保存完整的明代古城墙，可骑行环游。
attractions.desc_en: A well-preserved Ming-era wall you can cycle around.

attractions.desc_zh: 唐代古塔，玄奘译经之地，夜晚喷泉璀璨。
attractions.desc_en: A Tang pagoda where Xuanzang translated scriptures; dazzling fountains at night.

foods.desc_zh: 腊汁肉夹在白吉馍里，被称为「中式汉堡」。
foods.desc_en: Stewed meat in a baked bun—the 'Chinese hamburger'.

foods.desc_zh: 爽滑的米/面皮拌上辣油醋汁，开胃消暑。
foods.desc_en: Cool, slippery noodles tossed in chili oil and vinegar.

foods.desc_zh: 掰碎的馍泡进浓郁羊肉汤，西安招牌。
foods.desc_en: Torn flatbread soaked in rich mutton soup—a Xi'an signature.
